budgets.phase_budget_semantics: Existing scheduler stops new admissions with a 90-second reserve and retains every pending/not-started identity; external native execution owns the hard job bound.

independent_fit_unit: Training seed; cores, controllers, memory modes, regimes and episodes are paired conditions, not extra training repeats.

objective.failed_deployment_decision_utility: -1 - 0.01 * observed wall seconds; unavailable gross score stays null.
objective.gross: Independently pinned actual receipt delivery rubric in [0,1].
objective.retention_scope: Two retention-validation source groups for the current matched arms; no separate initial-checkpoint incumbent is included.

permitted_outcome: Engineering observations only; Inconclusive or Failed, no adoption or RSI claim.
purpose: Prospectively fixed real deployment evaluation of the two-seed matched-memory engineering pilot; no retraining or confirmation.

research_accounting.upstream_collection_and_training: Original receipts remain separately charged; do not double count nested model/evaluation work.

scope: Five constructed receipt workflows; two train source groups, one disjoint train-role tuning group, two development groups and two retention-validation groups.

source_selection.confirmation_release: DENIED; confirmation and retention_test are outside this execution.
source_selection.order: Unchanged collector study_id and SHA256 ordering; selected-sources bytes must match the collector plan.

statistics.analysis: Retain the full paired observations and failures for the separate causal analysis; this runner does not apply the old 24-contrast inference protocol.

budget_stop_analysis_policy.analysis_only_mapping: Map BudgetStop to statistical Completed only when an actual evaluator/rubric-bound finite score and an observed finite nonnegative deployment_wall_seconds are both present; otherwise use Unresolved.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.audit: Retain original and statistical status counts and every BudgetStop adaptation separately.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.meaning: Resolved statistical observation only; no claim of original execution success or acceptable quality.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.original_terminal_status: Preserve BudgetStop and the original paired rows.
budget_stop_analysis_policy.required_cost_scope: Measured deployment wall cost used by the frozen utility; energy and provider prices need not be known for this mapping.

tuning.criterion: Existing matrix.tune: mean observed net utility, equally weighted source groups and task families.
tuning.strongest_comparator: Select among fixed/VOI/MPC on either core separately within each seed/regime/memory mode; six comparator profiles per memory mode.
